title: Task Stop and Queue Mode Fix

sections.name: Task control
items: Stopping a task now immediately cancels its active checkout navigation, polling, and clicks.

sections.name: Queue mode
items: Wait for queue now monitors Pokémon Center until a real waiting room goes live.
The task waits in the queue until access is granted, then reuses the same browser session to open the assigned SKU and begin checkout.
Product signals no longer bypass queue mode while the task is waiting.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
